newsitem.title: CANADA: RTRS-Placer Dome to sell Gibraltar stake to Westmin.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Placer Dome to sell Gibraltar stake to Westmin.

text.p: Placer Dome Inc said on Tuesday it planned to tender its 30.8 percent holding in Gibraltar Mines to an offer for the entire company by Westmin Resources Ltd.
Placer Dome said Westmin was offering C$8.85 for every Gibraltar share up to C$86.6 million or 1.18 of a Westmin share based on a Westmin price of C$7.50 a share.

If Gibraltar shareholders choose the cash option, the consideration will be pro-rated as to C$2.50 in cash and 0.847 common shares of Westmin for every Gibraltar common share. Placer Dome agreed to elect to take its consideration in cash to the fullest extent available.
The deal is subject to due diligence and, subject to certain conditions, Placer Dome has the right to tender its shares to any higher offer that may materialize.
Placer Dome said last week it planned to sell its holding in Gibraltar.
Westmin Resources Ltd and Gibraltar Mines Ltd said on Tuesday Westmin will offer to acquire all of the shares of Gibraltar for about C$307 million, or C$8.85 per share.
Placer Dome Inc said it expected an after-tax gain of about US$11 million on the sale of its 30.8 percent stake in Gibraltar Mines Ltd to Westmin Resources Ltd.
Westmin is bidding C$8.85 a share in cash and stock for Gibraltar for a total value of C$307 million.
Gibraltar is a copper company. Placer, which focuses on gold mining, announced last week it intended to sell its stake in Gibraltar because it was not a core asset.
